ssl-pinning-bypass.summary: Bypass common Android SSL/TLS certificate pinning (TrustManager, OkHttp, WebView).

hostname-verifier-bypass.summary: Force HostnameVerifier to accept all hosts for TLS interception.

root-bypass.summary: Defeat common Android root-detection checks (file, package, exec).

biometric-bypass.summary: Force BiometricPrompt/Fingerprint auth callbacks to succeed (best-effort).

crypto-monitor.summary: Monitor javax.crypto Cipher usage: algorithm, key bytes and plaintext/ciphertext.

keystore-monitor.summary: Log Android KeyStore access (aliases, key/certificate operations).

sqlite-monitor.summary: Log SQLite queries and execSQL (data access + SQLi surface).

fileio-monitor.summary: Log file opens for read/write (insecure storage discovery).

intent-monitor.summary: Log Intent creation and component navigation (IPC surface).

logcat-monitor.summary: Log android.util.Log calls (apps often log secrets).

webview-inspect.summary: Log WebView.loadUrl / loadData / evaluateJavascript / addJavascriptInterface calls.

list-classes.summary: Enumerate loaded Java classes whose name contains a filter substring.

params.FILTER: Case-insensitive substring to match class names against.

method-trace.summary: Trace every overload of every method of a Java class, logging args and return values.

params.CLASS: Fully-qualified Java class name to trace, e.g. jakhar.aseem.diva.APICreds

hook-method.summary: Hook a single Java method (all overloads); log arguments and return value.

dump-stacktrace.summary: Print the Java call stack whenever a given method is invoked.

params.METHOD: Method name to trace the call stack for.
